description: This Java class 'Hooks' provides Cucumber lifecycle hooks for managing WebDriver setup and teardown in automated tests. It initializes a WebDriver before each scenario, captures screenshots on failures, and cleans up resources after each scenario.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Provides hooks for WebDriver lifecycle management in Cucumber tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver before each scenario, ensuring test isolation.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up WebDriver after each scenario, capturing a screenshot if the scenario fails.
